title: Agemonia
subtitle: A fully cooperative narrative campaign board game of heroic fantasy, moral dilemmas, and living world exploration
tagline: Unravel planar mysteries, balance stamina and resolve, and shape the destiny of a dying world
loreSummary: In the vibrant yet peril-fraught realm of Agemonia, cataclysmic celestial shifts awaken forgotten powers and ancient evils. As unlikely heroes bound together by fate, you must uncover deep conspiracies, navigate faction politics, and brave perilous expeditions to safeguard the future.
keyFeatures: Over 100 hours of rich storytelling across 38 distinct branching scenarios
Innovative stamina chip mechanic seamlessly blending character vitality and action economy
Fail-forward narrative progression ensuring story momentum without punishing road-blocks
Three-phase cycle: thriving Runedale City Step, treacherous Journey Step, and tactical Scenario Step

agemonia_standard.name: Standard Campaign Chronicle
agemonia_standard.description: The definitive Agemonia narrative journey traversing major faction storylines, key city districts, and epic planar confrontations across ~28 scenarios.

agemonia_expedited.name: Focused Critical Path (Core Arcs)
agemonia_expedited.description: A streamlined adventure driving directly through the central cataclysm storyline and critical realm crises across ~20 scenarios.

agemonia_completionist.name: Master Chronicler (All Scenarios & Side Quests)
agemonia_completionist.description: An exhaustive odyssey undertaking every hero side quest, companion origin story, provincial encounter, and hidden secret across all 38 scenarios.
